points.text: **16 of 20** BJP-named booth-level agents in Delhi's **Mustafabad** denied filing the **787** Form 7 deletion applications (of 1,021) against Muslim voters.
SC assured excluded Delhi voters they won't be prosecuted, but the ECI still insists they file **Form 6** (meant for new voters) instead of Form 8; case listed **19 November**.

SC sought the Centre's reply on pleas against **Section 16** of the **CEC and Other ECs (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023**, which gives the CEC/ECs **lifelong immunity** from prosecution.

SC: laws barring **more than two children** from local-body office have 'lost relevance' as India's **Total Fertility Rate (TFR)** **fell below the replacement rate** of 2.1, falling from **3.02 to 1.9** — this violates **Article 21**.
A 7-judge SC Bench held a **cess on sales tax** stays within a State's power under **Entry 54, List II**, reaffirming *S. Kodar v. Kerala* (1975).
India secured preliminary investment commitments worth **$400 billion** in renewables (hydrogen, storage, transmission).
Cabinet approved **VISTAR** — **₹4,371 crore** to overhaul India's statistical ecosystem (2026-31), including an economic census.
Cabinet approved a **₹14,500-crore** VGF scheme for **92 GWh** of new grid-scale energy storage, targeting **411 GWh** by 2031-32.
Cabinet approved a **₹2,814-crore** scheme for domestic **lithium and nickel** processing facilities (5 years).
Gold rose **3%** as the US dollar index hit a **5-week low of 101.3** ahead of the US midterm results.
Sensex closed at **77,301** (+383 pts) and Nifty at **23,960** (+149 pts) on 4 Nov — a fifth straight day of gains; India's VIX is up **65.4%** YTD.
**Mercedes-Benz** announced a fresh **₹200-crore** India investment (total ₹3,200 cr) and launched the electric **GLC SUV** (from ₹78.5 lakh).
Cabinet extended **Fast-Track Special Courts** (incl. POCSO courts) by 5 years; outlay **₹3,788.04 crore** from the **Nirbhaya Fund**; target **850** FTSCs.
Cabinet approved **two more years** of engagement so the **75%** of Agniveers not retained after 4 years can **serve** before being considered for regular enrolment.
Delhi's AQI rose to **377** ('very poor') on 5 Nov; stubble burning's share of its PM2.5 **doubled to 16.28%** (from 8.2%) in a day.
CPCB's AQI bands: **201-300 poor, 301-400 very poor, 401-450 severe, 451-500 severe plus**.
CAQM issued show-cause notices to police/district officials of **five Punjab districts** over stubble-burning non-compliance.
A *Nature* study found the **Amazon rainforest is now a net carbon source, not a sink** — wildfire emissions exceeded its absorption by **1.17 billion tonnes** of carbon.
US midterms: Democrats won **≥237/435** House seats and **≥54/100** Senate seats, flipping **7** Republican Senate seats (incl. Texas, Kansas, South Carolina).
US midterm 'firsts': **James Talarico** (Texas Senate), **Adam Hamilton** (first Dem Kansas senator since 1932), **Abdul El-Sayed** (first Muslim US Senator).
Democrats now hold **≥28/50** US governorships; **Gina Hinojosa** is Texas's first Democratic Governor since **1995**.
**Trump** congratulated Democrats, conceded the **Iran war** hurt Republicans, but warned he would **veto** Democratic bills.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards said **four oil tankers** caught fire after **striking naval mines** in the **Strait of Hormuz**; a US-made drone was shot down.
The US Treasury sanctioned firms in **India and Türkiye** for allegedly aiding Iran, under 'Operation Economic Outcast'.
**Nirmala Lakshman** (Director, The Hindu Group) won the **Sharjah Award** for Best International Non-Fiction Book for *'The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community'*.
**Virat Kohli** became the first in ODI history with a **50+ average across all four SENA nations** (SA, England, NZ, Australia).
India beat New Zealand by **5 wickets** (DLS) in the 1st ODI, Kohli scoring 74 on the eve of his 38th birthday; lead series **1-0**.
Ex-hockey captain **M.M. Somaya**'s **1980 Moscow Olympics gold** — India's last Olympic hockey gold — was stolen from his Bengaluru home.
India thrashed Korea **8-1** in the ACT hockey semifinal, to meet **Japan** in the first-ever India-Japan Asian Champions Trophy final.
**Kimi Antonelli** (Mercedes) became F1's **youngest-ever World Champion** (20y 68d), beating **Sebastian Vettel**'s record, as the first Italian champion since **Alberto Ascari (1953)**.
**Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu** became the first Indian to win a **wushu** medal at the Youth Olympics (bronze, Dakar).
**Abhinandh-Bhowmick** became the World No. 1 pair in under-19 mixed-doubles badminton.
